quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear reactor loss of coolant progressing toward core damage threshold. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate core damage prevention protocol.
quests.explanation: Core damage prevention combines ECCS activation, control rod insertion, and portable pump deployment simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hydrogen gas accumulating in the reactor building above the explosive limit. Input code!
quests.hint: Vent hydrogen from the reactor building.
quests.explanation: Controlled hydrogen venting prevents the explosive buildup that caused catastrophic building damage in historic nuclear accidents.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Site emergency declared with notification required to the national nuclear regulator. Input code!
quests.hint: Notify the national nuclear regulator immediately.
quests.explanation: Regulatory notification within 15 minutes of a site emergency is legally required and triggers national response resources.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cruise ship with 3,000 passengers declaring sinking emergency 50 miles offshore. Input code!
quests.hint: Declare a maritime mass casualty emergency code.
quests.explanation: Maritime MCI codes mobilize coast guard fleets, commercial rescue vessels, and naval assets for large-scale sea rescue.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ship listing 30 degrees with lifeboats inaccessible on the low side. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the alternate ship evacuation plan.
quests.explanation: Alternate plans deploy inflatable life rafts from the accessible high side when standard lifeboats are blocked.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rescue ships 20 miles away and helicopter capacity insufficient for 3,000 people. Input code!
quests.hint: Request naval assistance for the operation.
quests.explanation: Naval vessels provide the deck space and aviation assets needed for mass rescue operations at significant offshore distances.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Active conflict requiring civilian evacuation from the urban combat zone. Input code!
quests.hint: Establish a humanitarian civilian corridor.
quests.explanation: Humanitarian corridors create agreed ceasefire routes allowing civilians to move safely through active conflict areas.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Medical facilities in the conflict zone declaring critical supply shortages. Input code!
quests.hint: Order an airdrop medical resupply.
quests.explanation: Airborne medical resupply bypasses ground conflict to deliver essential supplies to facilities inside active zones.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International monitoring required to verify safe passage agreement compliance. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy an international monitoring team.
quests.explanation: International monitors provide independent verification of safe passage agreements, reducing the risk of corridor violations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pandemic operations center coordinating response across twelve health regions. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the pandemic emergency operations center.
quests.explanation: Pandemic EOC activation aligns all regional health authorities under centralized command and resource management.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hospital surge capacity reaching 95% with ICU overflow becoming critical. Input code!
quests.hint: Open emergency field hospital capacity.
quests.explanation: Field hospital activation redirects non-critical patients from overwhelmed facilities and expands treatment capacity rapidly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Vaccine distribution bottleneck identified in three underserved regions. Input priority code!
quests.hint: Route priority vaccine doses to underserved regions.
quests.explanation: Priority vaccine routing delivers doses to the highest-risk communities first to reduce mortality and transmission rates.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Large space debris fragment on a collision course with an active satellite cluster. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the debris tracking alert system.
quests.explanation: Debris tracking systems compute collision probability and provide satellite operators with avoidance burn data.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Satellite operators must maneuver assets within 90 minutes to avoid collision. Input code!
quests.hint: Open the satellite maneuver burn window.
quests.explanation: Maneuver burn windows are timed orbital adjustments that move satellites out of the debris path with minimal fuel cost.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Ground station communications lost with three satellites during the avoidance maneuver. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate ground station recovery tracking.
quests.explanation: Recovery tracking reacquires satellite signals using secondary ground stations when primary contact is lost.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cyber attack causing physical damage to industrial control systems at the power plant. Input code!
quests.hint: Isolate all industrial control systems from the cyber network.
quests.explanation: ICS isolation prevents cyber actors from sending further malicious commands to physical plant equipment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Plant operators unable to verify which systems are under attacker control. Input code!
quests.hint: Manually verify all system states.
quests.explanation: Physical manual verification confirms which systems are in safe states independent of potentially compromised displays.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Malware confirmed in the plant control network and spreading to adjacent systems. Input code!
quests.hint: Segment all network zones immediately.
quests.explanation: Network segmentation creates isolated barriers preventing malware from moving laterally between control system zones.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cascading power failure spreading across the national grid from triggered substations. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue cascade stop order to all substations.
quests.explanation: Cascade stop orders instruct substation operators to manually open breakers and prevent the failure from spreading further.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Frequency deviation too large to recover without emergency load shedding. Input code!
quests.hint: Implement national emergency load shedding.
quests.explanation: National load shedding on a defined schedule restores grid frequency balance by reducing demand faster than generation falls.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Black start procedure required to restore power to the de-energized national grid. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the national black start procedure.
quests.explanation: Black start procedures use self-starting generation units to rebuild the grid in sequence from isolated power islands.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Toxic chemical cloud dispersing over 12 city blocks from an industrial accident. Input code!
quests.hint: Generate toxic dispersion mapping.
quests.explanation: Atmospheric dispersion modeling predicts cloud movement and concentration, enabling precise evacuation zone delineation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Public shelter locations must be selected to remain upwind of the toxic cloud. Input code!
quests.hint: Designate upwind shelter sites only.
quests.explanation: Upwind shelter sites keep evacuating residents out of the path of toxic cloud movement during dispersion events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cloud beginning to dissipate and air quality monitoring needed before return. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy air quality clearance monitoring.
quests.explanation: Air quality monitoring confirms concentrations are below toxic thresholds before authorities permit residents to return.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Mass casualty incident with 450 patients requiring advanced triage operations. Input code!
quests.hint: Implement the START triage system.
quests.explanation: Simple Triage and Rapid Treatment uses a 60-second assessment to categorize each patient by urgency across mass casualty events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Red-tagged patients exceeding hospital intensive care capacity in the region. Input code!
quests.hint: Divert critical patients to additional facilities.
quests.explanation: Patient diversion protocols distribute critical cases across multiple facilities to prevent any single hospital from being overwhelmed.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Family reunification center needed at the mass casualty site. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the family reunification unit.
quests.explanation: Family reunification centers centralize records of admitted patients, helping families locate loved ones during chaotic events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National emergency requiring coordination across all government departments. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the national emergency operations center.
quests.explanation: National EOC activation brings all government ministries under coordinated emergency command for maximum response efficiency.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International mutual aid agreements being activated for the national emergency. Input code!
quests.hint: Engage all international mutual aid agreements.
quests.explanation: Mutual aid engagement unlocks pre-negotiated resource sharing agreements with allied nations for large-scale disasters.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National recovery framework must be initiated alongside the active emergency response. Input code!
quests.hint: Initiate national recovery phase one.
quests.explanation: Simultaneous recovery planning ensures reconstruction resources are organized before the acute emergency phase concludes.
